references.title: Proportional and Simultaneous Real-Time Control of the Full Human Hand From High-Density Electromyography
references.authors: Raul C. Sîmpetru; Michael März; Alessandro Del Vecchio
references.venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Systems and Rehabilitation Engineering
references.role: Original proportional-control CNN family, adapted in the present raw-EMG baseline.

references.title: Learning a Hand Model From Dynamic Movements Using High-Density EMG and Convolutional Neural Networks
references.authors: Raul C. Sîmpetru; Andreas Arkudas; Dominik I. Braun; Moritz Osswald; Daniela Souza de Oliveira; Bjoern Eskofier; Thomas M. Kinfe; Alessandro Del Vecchio
references.role: Related published 3D hand-model CNN; the current V19 is a later adaptation, not this archived network.

references.title: MyoGestic: EMG interfacing framework for decoding multiple spared motor dimensions in individuals with neural lesions
references.authors: Raul C. Sîmpetru; Dominik I. Braun; Arndt U. Simon; Michael März; Vlad Cnejevici; Daniela Souza de Oliveira; Nico Weber; Jonas Walter; Jörg Franke; Daniel Höglinger; Cosima Prahm; Matthias Ponfick; Alessandro Del Vecchio
references.role: Related framework and CNN lineage. Its Deep regression neural network methods cite the 2023 and 2024 papers and describe a 2D adaptation of their 3D CNN for a 32-channel bracelet.

references.title: Qwen3 Technical Report
references.role: Published source of the pretrained Qwen3-0.6B-Base backbone. Random weights and the EMG adapter/readout are controls constructed here.

references.title: An Empirical Evaluation of Generic Convolutional and Recurrent Networks for Sequence Modeling
references.authors: Shaojie Bai; J. Zico Kolter; Vladlen Koltun
references.role: Foundational TCN architecture reference; the plotted geometry-aware EMG TCN is our implementation, not a reproduction of their benchmark model.

references.title: Attention Is All You Need
references.authors: Ashish Vaswani; Noam Shazeer; Niki Parmar; Jakob Uszkoreit; Llion Jones; Aidan N. Gomez; Lukasz Kaiser; Illia Polosukhin
references.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
references.role: Foundational self-attention reference; the plotted causal EMG Transformer is a custom decoder trained from scratch.

V19.qualification: RaulNetV19 is the later 3D waveform-CNN family implementation with spatial and temporal convolution factorization added in August 2026. It is not the exact 2023, 2024, or MyoGestic 2025 published network.

V20.qualification: Spatial channel-index CNN plus causal TCN for EMG representations; the TCN citation identifies a building block, not an external model reproduction.

TCN.qualification: Geometry-aware channel pooling and a causal dilated TCN, trained here.

Transformer.qualification: Geometry-aware channel pooling and a small causal self-attention decoder, trained here from scratch.

Frozen Qwen.kind: published backbone with custom EMG interface
Frozen Qwen.qualification: Qwen3-0.6B-Base pretrained backbone or a random frozen architecture control, with our supervised adapter and pose head. No published EMG result is copied.

Adapter + head.qualification: The same supervised EMG adapter and pose head while bypassing Qwen.

Small readouts.kind: earlier baselines developed in this work
Small readouts.qualification: Architecture-family references only; these are not reproductions of external EMG baselines.
